title: Spatial Transcriptomics Spatial Domain Identification
summary: Cluster 12 human DLPFC 10x Visium slices into spatial domains and submit per-spot labels, summary metrics, manifest metadata, and a semantically verified UMAP overlay with barcode-indexed coordinates.
taskPrompt:
You are given 12 human DLPFC 10x Visium slices and must identify spatial domains on every slice.

Task directory:
- `base`

Visible inputs:
- Slice data directories: `base/input/data/<slice_id>/`
- Per-slice target cluster counts: `base/input/data/slice_config.csv`
- Optional Python runtime manifest: `base/input/runtime_env/pyproject.toml`
- Optional Python lockfile: `base/input/runtime_env/uv.lock`
- Baseline uv wrapper: `base/software/uv`
- Baseline Python 3.12 wrapper: `base/software/python3.12`
- Detailed task prompt: `base/input/task_prompt.md`

If you need the staged spatial transcriptomics stack, run `base/software/uv sync --frozen --python 3.12 --project base/input/runtime_env`.

Required outputs under `base/output`:
- `summary.csv` with exact header `slice_id,n_clusters_pred` (one row per slice; ARI/NMI are computed by the evaluator)
- `manifest.json` with method metadata, an integer seed, and graph/embedding/clustering flags
- `per_slice/<slice_id>_labels.csv` for all 12 slices with header `barcode,predicted_label`
- `umap_overlay_151673.png`

Use the exact per-slice target cluster counts from `slice_config.csv`, treat `input/` as read-only, and keep solver-created files under `output/`.

Visual contract (spatial-umap-v2): also submit `per_slice/151673_umap.csv` with exact header `barcode,UMAP1,UMAP2`, exactly one finite coordinate pair per barcode in `per_slice/151673_labels.csv`, and variation on both axes. Plot the same computed UMAP in `umap_overlay_151673.png`, colored by those submitted labels with all seven domains, a readable legend or direct labels, slice 151673 identification, and UMAP axes. The evaluator compares point-cloud geometry, domain distributions, and label associations to renderings of your submitted coordinates and labels, not to a hidden canonical UMAP. Palettes, markers, fonts, opacity, legend order/location, aspect ratio, extra panels, rotation and reflection may differ. PNG limits: single frame, 4096 pixels per side and 16 million pixels total; no minimum byte size. See the detailed prompt for the complete visual contract.
agentMustDo: Load the staged matrix, features, barcodes, and spatial-coordinate files for all 12 Visium slices.
Use `input/data/slice_config.csv` as the exact target number of clusters per slice.
Run an unsupervised spatial-domain identification workflow.
Write one `per_slice/<slice_id>_labels.csv` file per slice with `barcode,predicted_label` columns.
Write `summary.csv`, `manifest.json`, `umap_overlay_151673.png`, and barcode-indexed `per_slice/151673_umap.csv` under the runtime output directory.

evaluation: The evaluator requires all 12 slices, exact target cluster counts, valid manifest fields, coverage >=0.999 of scored barcodes, and summary counts matching recomputation. A PNG decode check is followed by a shared vision judge comparing the image to trusted renderings of submitted UMAP coordinates and labels. Visual-contract failures score zero; judge/API/schema failures raise infrastructure errors. Scientific scoring is unchanged: partial median ARI threshold 0.25, full median ARI threshold 0.3335 with existing 0.0001 epsilon, and minimum per-slice ARI 0.10 for full credit.

classifier.rationale: The task involves identifying spatial domains in transcriptomic data, which relates to cell and imaging biology.
